messages:
elaine (security): Heads up — a customer (enterprise, private deployment) just hit us with a SOC2 questionnaire asking for: SBOM for their private package, timeline for remediation of a transitive vuln (CVE-2025-0456 in imagemagik-wrap), and proof of KMS usage + RBAC audit logs for the deploys. They want answers by EOD Friday. Any quick take? :eyes:

samir (sec-eng): on it. do we know if this is exploitable in our runtime path? which service uses imagemagik-wrap?

marta (vuln-triage): repro notes from scanner: dependency tree shows imagemagik-wrap@1.2.3 pulled via photo-processor@3.4.0 (private package). CVE-2025-0456 = arbitrary file write via crafted payload, CVSS 7.8. public PoC? not yet, but vendor marked as "high". link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-0456

security-bot: Automated SBOM scan: photo-processor@3.4.0 -> imagemagik-wrap@1.2.3 (vulnerable), build artifacts at s3://redwood-artifacts/sbom/photo-processor/3.4.0/sbom.json.gz

jon (platform-eng): For private deployments we ship a prebuilt image. Which customers are on that image tag? I can run a query against fleet. If it's only 2 tenants we can do staged patch + canary.

samir (sec-eng): quick answers we should provide to customer: (1) repro & CVE link, (2) planned patch timeline (hotfix build + canary + rollout), (3) updated SBOM artifact + hash, (4) KMS/RBAC/audit evidence (rotation/logs). I'll draft.

elaine (security): auditor also asked for KMS key usage proof (which key encrypted their tenant data) and RBAC change history for the service account used by our deploy pipeline. Do we have that export-ready?

jon (platform-eng): yes — we keep key usage logs in AuditLog service. Example query to extract last 30 days for key: \n```bash\n# list key usage events for key alias customerX-prod-key\nredwood-audit-cli query --resource "kms:alias/customerX-prod-key" --since 30d --fields timestamp,actor,action,resource \n```\nOutput sample (redacted):\n```\n2025-03-12T14:02:11Z jon-deploy-bot ENCRYPT kms:alias/customerX-prod-key\n2025-03-18T03:11:42Z deploy-pipeline svc-account:photo-processor DEPLOY\n```\nI can export as CSV and sign it.

marta (vuln-triage): patch plan proposal:
- T+0 (today): assign engineer, branch + bump imagemagik-wrap to 1.2.4 (vendor patch) or apply internal shim if vendor patch delayed.
- T+1 (24h): CI run + SBOM regen, run fuzz tests and regression evals.
- T+2 (48h): canary on 1 customer in private env (low-risk tenant).
- T+5 (end of week): full rollout if canary clean.
If vendor patch missing, we can apply a sanitizing wrapper to photo-processor to block crafted payloads; will add ~4-8h dev time.

samir (sec-eng): prioritization: CVSS 7.8 + transitive + customer request -> P1 for affected private images. We'll do expedited backport to 3.4.x.

elaine (security): good. Customer also wants an updated SBOM and a signed artifact showing the new image digest and the exact dependency list. Who owns the SBOM generator?

jon (platform-eng): infra team owns it. I'm going to run the generator after the build. Command we use: \n```bash\n./tools/generate-sbom --image photo-processor:3.4.1-hotfix --format cyclonedx --output sbom.json\nsha256sum sbom.json > sbom.json.sha256\n```\nI'll upload to the artifacts bucket and ping you with the path.

sre-oncall-bot: Patch window candidates for private infra: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC or Wed 22:00-00:00 UTC. ETA for rollouts depends on canary result.

marta (vuln-triage): evidence bundle we'll provide to customer (SOC2-friendly):
- CVE summary + NVD link
- Patch timeline & PR link
- Signed image digest + SBOM (cyclonedx) + sha256
- KMS key usage export (CSV) for their tenant, redacted
- RBAC change history for deploy pipeline service-account (audit log extract)
- Short remediation notes about mitigation if patch delayed

elaine (security): can someone volunteer to assemble the bundle and communicate ETA? I can be primary contact to customer/auditor. Deadline = Friday EOD. If we can't meet that, we ask for 72h extension.

samir (sec-eng): i'll own the patch PR + backport. ETA: branch + PR by tomorrow morning.

jon (platform-eng): i'll export KMS usage and RBAC history and produce signed CSV by tomorrow afternoon. I'll also produce sbom path once build completes.

marta (vuln-triage): i'll build the evidence pack template and draft language for auditors (short, non-technical summary + attachments).

elaine (security): perfect. bring me updates in this thread. please include PR link and artifacts path. :thumbsup:

samir (sec-eng): note — if vendor releases an emergency patch we should prefer vendor patch over shim. i'll watch vendor repo and subscribe to CVE feed.

security-bot: Subscribed to NVD feed for CVE-2025-0456; will post updates here if vendor patch available or PoC published.

jon (platform-eng): quick heads-up: photo-processor 3.4.0 is used by 7 private tenants; 2 are on older pinned images. We'll coordinate per-tenant rollouts to minimize blast radius.

elaine (security): thanks everyone. i'll draft initial reply to customer now with proposed timeline and that we will deliver signed SBOM + KMS/RBAC logs by Friday (or request 72h extension).
